activity_context.topic_title: The Coordinates of a Vector Relative to a Basis in Abstract Vector Spaces

feedback.problem:
Consider the following polynomials:

$$
{p}_{1}(t)=1-3{t}^{2},\,{p}_{2}(t)=-3t+{t}^{2},\,q(t)=2-3t-5{t}^{2}.
$$

If $B={{p}_{1}(t),{p}_{2}(t)}$ is a basis of $\text{Span}{{p}_{1}(t),{p}_{2}(t)},$ and $[q(t)]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}],$ then ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=$
feedback.worked_solution:
We need to find ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ such that 

$$
{x}_{1}{p}_{1}(t)+{x}_{2}{p}_{2}(t)=q(t)
$$

Substituting the given information into the above equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}(1-3{t}^{2})+{x}_{2}(-3t+{t}^{2}) & =2-3t-5{t}^{2} \\ {x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}t+(-3{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}){t}^{2} & =2-3t-5{t}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the coefficients of $t$, we obtain

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}=2 \\ -3{x}_{2}=-3 \\ -3{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=-5.\end{aligned}
$$

 

The equations above give a linear system with the augmented matrix

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & -3 & -3 \\ -3 & 1 & -5\end{aligned}].
$$

Row-reducing the matrix using Gaussian elimination, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}M= & [\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & -3 & -3 \\ -3 & 1 & -5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+3{R}_{1} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & -3 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+\frac{1}{3}{R}_{2} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & -3 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}=2 \\ -3{x}_{2}=-3.\end{aligned}
$$

From the first and second equations, we get ${x}_{1}=2$ and ${x}_{2}=1.$ 

Therefore, $[q(t)]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1\end{aligned}].$

Finally, ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=2+1=3.$
